tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The company shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
All terms and conditions as per uploaded bid documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Technical bid format (Appendix-A) is to be filled and uploaded
Format of undertaking (Appendix - G) is to be filled and uploaded
If the tenderer is a MSE, upload the NSIC certificate as prescribed in Appendix-E.
If the tenderer is a MSE, Format of Self - Declaration of MSE Registered with NSIC (Appendix - E) is to be filled and uploaded
Format of Declaration (Appendix - F) is to be filled and uploaded
GST / GST Registration number and copy of Company Registration Certificate has to be uploaded
Format of Self-Declaration of Documents Furnished in Appendix -A i.e. Appendix - D is to be filled and uploaded
Format of Pre-shipment sample undertaking (Appendix - I) is to be filled and uploaded
Appendix - L: Format of Undertaking of Criminal Case / Conviction is to be filled and uploaded
